limitations: Local WSL2, shared host, service quotas 3 app CPU + 1 PostgreSQL CPU versus 6 app CPU + 2 PostgreSQL CPU; not physical cloud servers.
Application RAM cap 4GiB, PostgreSQL 1GiB; independent load generator 2 CPU/1GiB outside service quota. Host roughly 7.65GiB.
Two repeated 30s browse and 60s mixed phases per worker count, closed loop; not a long soak, fixed-arrival-rate or internet/HTTPS latency test.
Synthetic WeChat exchange; normal activation password derivation and business transactions retained.
400 products with 10 SKUs each; all 4000 inventory rows ledger-backed; 400 synthetic image files with identical generated JPEG content.
100 continuous browser tasks, plus 24 parallel activations and 24 scarce-stock checkout attempts per mixed phase; two serial OCR uploads per mixed phase.
No simultaneous multiple-operator OCR batch capacity claim; images served by application, no CDN or public bandwidth shaping.
9 PostgreSQL environment test classes skipped by full suite; new mixed correctness explicitly exercised PostgreSQL16. Prior round standalone66 not claimed rerun.
Actual cloud SKU, disk, network and pricing still need validation on purchased test server.
